title: Dylan Borland: the energy system is the most sensitive secret

tellings.quote: Dylan Borland literally said you know the most classified thing most sensitive thing is not the craft it's the energy system.

plain: The most closely guarded secret is not the craft but the energy system that powers it, according to a man named Dylan Borland. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb (UAP is the government's term for UFOs) quotes Borland to Michels: "the most sensitive thing is not the craft it's the energy system." If true, the real secret would be a power source, not the vehicles.
